research_notes: Follow-up: identify early retail employer and dates, verify DPC facilitation appointment, ministerial office boundaries, DJCS executive/acting terms, hours and leave. Resolve 2021–2022 work and Bouverie clinical/study overlap; establish VACCA historical governance and university treatment.

2026-09-29 review: APH, first speech, La Trobe employer/alumni source, VACCA organisational sources, official traditional-owner review and IPAA senior-role list. Broader adviser/department queries resolved department and titles but not individual appointment dates/FTE.

DPC Right People for Country appeared only in a contact-aggregator result and is retained as a lead, not adopted as verified payroll identity. Ministerial staff cannot be merged into departmental public service merely because dates are adjacent.
No day boundaries, FTE or zero totals invented. EPOF 2019–2021 is a collective forum period, not proof of her whole tenure. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; unresolved initial record.
